months.note: 봄과 가을에 지나가며, 원문은 산란기를 5월 하순~8월경으로 적었다.

summary: 봄과 가을에 우리나라 전역을 드물게 지나가는 나그네새로, 논과 소택지, 풀숲에서 지낸다. 날도래 같은 곤충을 주로 먹고 작은 조개류 같은 연체동물이나 식물 씨앗도 먹는다. 호숫가 풀숲이나 물풀 위, 늪, 논 등지에 둥지를 틀고 한배에 알을 6~8개 낳는다. 일본, 타이완, 중국 북동부, 우수리, 사할린, 시베리아 등지에 분포한다.

art.subject: Baillon's Crake (Zapornia pusilla), adult as seen in Korean paddies and marshes on spring passage (April–May): crown and hindneck warm rufous-brown streaked black; a rufous-brown stripe through the eye; supercilium, face, foreneck, breast and upper belly blue-grey; chin and throat whitish; upperparts warm rufous-brown with bold black streaks and irregular small white streaks and flecks; rear flanks, lower belly and undertail coverts barred black and white; tail dark brown fringed rufous. Short, straight green bill; red iris; legs dull greenish.
art.pose: walking through wet grass at a rice-field edge, side view
art.scene: Korean spring rice paddies and marsh with grassy edges; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view walking through wet grass: rufous-brown upperparts with bold black streaks and white flecks, blue-grey face and underparts, black-and-white barred rear flanks, short green bill, red eye
adult, head detail: rufous-brown crown streaked black, pale blue-grey supercilium above a rufous-brown eye-stripe, whitish chin and throat, short straight green bill
art.build: Tiny crake, about 18cm long, between a sparrow and a starling in size; round, laterally compressed body with a small head. Bill short (shorter than the head), straight, fine and pointed. Legs fairly short with long toes. Very short tail, often cocked. At rest the wingtips fall well short of the tail tip (short primary projection). Creeps mouse-like through wet grass and over floating vegetation.
avoid: Do not paint a plain unmarked back; the upperparts carry bold black streaks and white flecks.
Do not paint a rufous-chestnut breast — that is Ruddy-breasted Crake.
Do not paint a long red bill like a rail; the bill is short and green.
Do not paint large, chicken-like proportions; it is a tiny crake.
